title: AI Game Dev Pop Dynasty
author: Fun_Tumbleweed_3682
selftext:
Hello! I am the developer of \*Pop Dynasty\*, an idle management simulation game where you run an entertainment agency. You can currently play a free demo version on Steam:



Steam (Play the demo and add to your wishlist):

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5579680/Pop\_Dynasty\_Demo/?beta=0](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5579680/Pop_Dynasty_Demo/?beta=0)



Trailer Video:





Core Gameplay Loop



\- Recruit pop stars, each with their own unique talents and traits.

\- Assign your pop stars to various activities: improve their stats through training, boost their charm at the clinic, and generate revenue and fame through different engagements. Send them on tours to earn significant profits—and perhaps even discover new equipment along the way.

\- Utilize facilities and advertising campaigns to enhance your agency as a whole or boost the capabilities of individual pop stars.

\- Your agency continues to operate even when you’re not playing.

\- Build your team and compete in awards shows. Each event consists of multiple rounds—covering categories like talent, charm, and fame, as well as special rounds such as "Ace Showdown" or "Team Harmony"—where you must win a majority of the rounds to claim overall victory.

\- Winning an awards show for the first time earns you a trophy; collecting more trophies makes your entire agency even more powerful.



Demo Version Content



\- The start of the first "Generation": Includes 10 pop stars and 3 awards shows, offering approximately 30 minutes of gameplay.

\- Higher-tier trainers, tours, and clinics are currently locked, but you can view them as blurred-out previews. - In the demo version, rewards for offline progress accumulate for a maximum of 1 hour (in the full version, they can accumulate for up to 12 hours).

\- Play data from the demo version cannot be transferred to the full version.



Full Version Content



\- Features 200 pop stars, 150 awards ceremonies, trainers across 8 different fields, and 30 types of activities.

\- Winning the "Generation Finale" triggers the start of a new generation. While I’ll keep the details of what carries over to the next generation a secret, some names will certainly never be forgotten.



Supported Platforms: Windows.

Supported Languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Spanish (Latin American), and Portuguese (Brazilian).



I would love to hear your feedback on the game’s overall structure, style, and pacing. I am currently generating images for the pop stars in the full version and am open to suggestions for improvement.



Disclosure of AI Usage



\- Code: Written by me, with AI used for recommendations and review.

\- Graphics: AI was used to create in-game characters and assets, which I then personally reviewed.

\- Text: AI was used for translation.

\- Sound: AI was used for generation, followed by my own manual review.



I relied on AI for code review, while handling the review of other elements personally. Is it possible to clearly distinguish between human review and AI review in your experience?



Personally, I feel uneasy if I don’t review everything myself, so I even built a dedicated web page to facilitate my own manual review process.



What kind of workflow do you use?
